newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanese pound continues rise on dollar in week.
newsitem.headline: Lebanese pound continues rise on dollar in week.

text.p: The Lebanese pound continued to rise against the dollar in a quiet market in the week ended on Friday, dealers said.

The Bank of Lebanon lowered its bid-offer intervention band during the week to 1,537-1,546.5 pounds per dollar from 1,537.5-1,547 and the dollar traded at the bottom of the band throughout the week, dealers said.
"The market was very quiet and relaxed this week. The dollar was over-supplied. No big commercial or financial operations were reported," a dealer told Reuters.
The dollar was restricted to a tight range of up to 35 piastres at the bid end of the intervention band, putting it at 1,537.35, he said.
Last week the dollar closed at 1,537.60-1,538 pound in interbank trading.
